map.ALSFRS-R是ALS临床试验和临床随访的核心量表。每月下降≥0.5分提示疾病: ALSFRS-R is the core scale for ALS clinical trials and follow-up. A decline ≥0.5 points/month indicates rapid progression. FVC<50% predicted or FVC sitting↓>20% warrants initiation of non-invasive ventilation (NIV). Riluzole/edaravone slow functional decline. Score change is an important indicator of drug efficacy and disease progression.

map.合计降至 28 分：球部与呼吸项下降明显，提示进展期，须监测通气。: Total drops to 28: bulbar and respiratory items decline markedly, indicating progressive stage, monitor ventilation.
